from_selection: create an iterator of MEG recordings from a selection dict with study name and optional parameters
Recording_iter: build a subclass of Recording that implements iter to list all recordings in a brain imaging study
Recording_preprocessed: create a resampled and highpass-filtered MEG RawArray at a specified sample rate from a Recording instance
preprocess_mne: build a new MNE RawArray by resampling and applying a highpass filter to existing MEG data
list_selections: summarize all preselections defined in the selections_definitions.yaml config file as Recording type tuples
